name: What factors influence the lifespan of a tiled floor?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the lifespan of a tiled floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a tiled floor is influenced by several key factors. The quality of the tile material itself, with porcelain and natural stone generally outlasting ceramic, plays a significant role. Proper subfloor preparation and professional installation are crucial, as a well-installed tile floor is less prone to cracking or loosening. The level of traffic the floor receives, along with consistent maintenance, also impacts its durability. High-traffic areas or those exposed to harsh conditions will naturally show wear sooner.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiled floor lifespan depends on tile quality, professional installation, proper subfloor prep, traffic levels, and consistent maintenance.
